name: @microdelta/supervision
description: Run Supervision: scoped run lifetime, execution admission and lifecycle observer positions

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.json && node ../../tooling/trim-declaration-imports.mjs dist/api/supervision.beta.d.ts dist/api/supervision.public.d.ts
scripts.check: concurrently --success all --names types,lint "npm run check:types" "npm run check:lint"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:types && npm run test:public
